# Toolzy llms.txt — AI/LLM discovery file
# https://toolzy.lovable.app

## Image Metadata Viewer

URL: https://toolzy.lovable.app/image-metadata
Category: Images & Privacy

Inspect JPEG, PNG, and classic TIFF metadata locally with exifr. Pick or drop a file up to 25 MiB; preview JPEG/PNG, inspect file details and available dimensions, search categorized EXIF/camera/GPS/date/IPTC/XMP/other tags, and copy values or coordinates. Export JSON or formula-safe CSV locally. Privacy findings explain detected timestamps, GPS, serial numbers, creator/owner fields, location descriptions, and EXIF thumbnails without inventing a score. Images and metadata are not uploaded or persistently stored. TIFF previews, WebP, HEIC/HEIF, RAW, BigTIFF, and metadata removal are not supported. No detected fields is not a guarantee of anonymity or complete parser coverage.

## Encoding Hub

URL: https://toolzy.lovable.app/encode
Category: Encoding & Serialisation

Encode and decode text and files using Base64, URL-safe Base64,
percent-encoding, and Data URLs — entirely in the browser.

Capabilities:
- Base64 encode and decode (UTF-8 safe, handles multibyte characters)
- Base64 URL-safe encode and decode (+ → -, / → _, no padding)
- URL percent-encode and decode with four sub-modes: encodeURIComponent,
  encodeURI, form (x-www-form-urlencoded), RFC 3986 strict
- Data URL builder (text or file → data:[mime];base64,[data]) and decoder
  with inline image and text previews
- File encode: drag-and-drop any file to Base64 or Data URL
- Query-string table editor: parse, edit, and rebuild URL parameters
- Batch mode: encode or decode multiple lines at once (Text / JSON / CSV output)
- Character breakdown: Unicode code points and percent-encoded byte sequences
- Security scanner: flags XSS and SQL-injection patterns in URL inputs
- Auto-detect mode: identifies the encoding type and routes automatically
- All processing is client-side; no data is transmitted

Example queries this tool answers:
- "Encode this text to Base64"
- "Decode this Base64 string"
- "What does this percent-encoded URL decode to?"
- "Convert this image file to a data URL"
- "Parse the query parameters from this URL"
- "What is the difference between encodeURI and encodeURIComponent?"
- "Encode this string using RFC 3986"
## JWT Hub

URL: https://toolzy.lovable.app/jwt
Category: Authentication & Security

Decode, encode, and verify JSON Web Tokens (JWTs) entirely in the browser. No data leaves the client.

Capabilities:
- Decode any JWT and inspect header, payload, and claims (exp, nbf, iat, iss, aud, sub)
- Encode and sign new JWTs using HS256, HS384, HS512, RS256, or ES256 via the Web Crypto API
- Verify JWT signatures with a secret or public key (HMAC and RSA/ECDSA)
- Security score card grading token safety: algorithm strength, secret length, claim presence, expiry window
- Token history (last 10 tokens, localStorage)
- Server-side verification code examples in Node.js, Python, Go, and PHP

Example queries this tool answers:
- "Decode this JWT and show me the payload"
- "Generate a signed HS256 JWT with a 1-hour expiry"
- "Is this JWT signature valid?"
- "What claims are missing from this token?"
- "How do I verify a JWT in Node.js?"

## Crypto Suite

URL: https://toolzy.lovable.app/crypto
Category: Cryptography & Identifiers

Generate cryptographic hashes and universally unique identifiers entirely
in the browser using the native Web Crypto API.

Capabilities — Hashing tab:
- Compute SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512 hashes from text, files, or hex
  input simultaneously
- Output formats: hex (lower/upper), Base64, Base64 URL-safe
- HMAC mode: HMAC-SHA-256, HMAC-SHA-384, HMAC-SHA-512 with a secret key
- File hashing up to 500 MB via Web Worker with progress indicator
- Hash comparison with character-level diff highlighting
- Algorithm visibility toggles, persisted in localStorage
- Hash history (last 10 inputs)
- MD5 intentionally not supported (cryptographically broken)

Capabilities — UUID Generator tab:
- Generate UUID v1 (timestamp), v3 (MD5/namespace), v4 (random via
  crypto.getRandomValues), v5 (SHA-1/namespace)
- Bulk generation up to 10,000 UUIDs with virtualised results list
- Formatting: uppercase, no hyphens, braces, urn:uuid: prefix
- UUID validator: detect version, variant, well-formedness
- v1 decoder: extract timestamp, clock sequence, node
- Export: CSV, JSON, SQL INSERT, plain TXT
- Code snippets: JavaScript, Python, Go, SQL
- UUID comparison with field-by-field breakdown and timestamp diff for v1
- Nil UUID and Max UUID (RFC 9562) quick-copy shortcuts

Example queries this tool answers:
- "Generate the SHA-256 hash of this text"
- "What is the SHA-512 hash of this file?"
- "Compute HMAC-SHA-256 with this secret key"
- "Generate 1000 UUID v4 tokens and export as CSV"
- "Is this a valid UUID? What version is it?"
- "What timestamp is embedded in this v1 UUID?"
- "Generate a UUID v5 from this namespace and name"
- "What is the difference between SHA-256 and SHA-512?"

## JSON Formatter

URL: https://toolzy.lovable.app/json
Category: Data Formatting

Format, validate, minify, and explore JSON entirely in the browser.

Capabilities:
- Pretty-print with 2-space, 4-space, or tab indentation; minify
- Interactive tree view with click-to-copy JSONPath per node
- Search/filter keys and values with match highlighting
- Sort keys recursively
- Export to JSON, CSV, XML, or YAML
- JSON Schema generation and validation
- Stats: size, depth, key counts
- Shareable links with JSON encoded in the URL
- File upload (.json) and 100% client-side processing

Example queries this tool answers:
- "Format this JSON with proper indentation"
- "Validate this JSON and show me the error"
- "Convert this JSON to CSV"
- "Generate a JSON schema from this payload"

## Color Converter

URL: https://toolzy.lovable.app/color
Category: Design & Color

Convert colors between formats, build palettes, check accessibility contrast,
and extract colors from images — all client-side.

Capabilities:
- Convert between HEX, RGB, HSL, HSV, CMYK, and CSS color names
- Tailwind class suggestion for the nearest palette color
- Palette generation: complementary, analogous, triadic, shades, tints
- WCAG contrast checker with AA/AAA grades for normal and large text
- Gradient builder with CSS output
- Image color extraction via Canvas (drag and drop)
- Batch conversion mode
- Eyedropper: pick any color from the screen (where supported)
- History and favorites, persisted locally

Example queries this tool answers:
- "Convert #3ecfcf to RGB and HSL"
- "What is the contrast ratio between these two colors?"
- "Generate a complementary palette for this color"
- "Extract the dominant colors from this image"

## API Diff

URL: https://toolzy.lovable.app/diff
Category: Testing & Debugging

Compare two API responses or data payloads and see structural differences.

Capabilities:
- Structural diffing of JSON, XML, HTML, and plain text
- Tree and table diff views
- Ignore rules for volatile fields (timestamps, IDs)
- Filtering: show only added, removed, or changed nodes
- Export diff results

Example queries this tool answers:
- "Compare these two JSON API responses"
- "What changed between these two payloads?"

## Fake Data Generator

URL: https://toolzy.lovable.app/fake-data
Category: Testing & Debugging

Generate realistic fake user data in JSON for testing and development.

Capabilities:
- Names, emails, phone numbers, addresses, ages, UUIDs
- 1–100 records per generation
- JSON output, copy or download
- 100% client-side, no real personal data

## Environment File Generator

URL: https://toolzy.lovable.app/env
Category: Configuration

Build .env configuration files from framework templates.

Capabilities:
- Templates for Node.js, Laravel, Spring Boot, React, and Django
- Custom key-value pairs
- Copy to clipboard or download as .env
- Runs entirely in the browser — secrets never leave the machine

## Date & Time Toolkit

URL: https://toolzy.lovable.app/datetime
Category: Time & Scheduling

Convert timestamps, compare timezones, calculate date differences, and build cron expressions.

Capabilities:
- Unix timestamp ↔ ISO 8601 conversion with relative time ("2h ago")
- Timezone converter: 400+ IANA zones, searchable, with live UTC offsets
- Date difference calculator (days, hours, minutes between two dates)
- Cron expression builder with visual field breakdown and presets
- Live UTC clock

Example queries this tool answers:
- "What date is Unix timestamp 1727740800?"
- "How many days between these two dates?"
- "Convert 3pm New York time to Tokyo time"
- "Build a cron expression for every Monday at 9 AM"

## Regex Playground

URL: https://toolzy.lovable.app/regex
Category: Testing & Debugging

Test regular expressions live with match highlighting and capture groups.

Capabilities:
- Real-time matching with debounced processing
- Match highlighting, positions, and named capture groups
- Flag support (g, i, m, s, u, y)
- Library of common patterns (email, URL, IPv4, phone, hex color, ISO date)
- Shareable links with pattern and test text encoded in the URL

Example queries this tool answers:
- "Test this regex against my text"
- "What does this regex match?"
- "Regex to validate an email address"
